svg.title: VSTMS premium industrial responsive dashboard concept
svg.desc: A desktop and mobile workshop dashboard showing up to five TGSPDCL TNotes containing received-state transformers. Each TNote belongs to one SPM Center and can contain up to ten transformers, alongside private orders, payroll, quotations, bills, and delivery challans.

g.text: A calmer way to run the workshop

svg.text: A premium industrial workspace, designed around real private-order and TGSPDCL workflows.
